Summary: Checks the security of a Twilio SendGrid account: every authenticated domain is validated (DKIM and DMARC alignment), API keys have least privilege, Enforced TLS is on, and the account, subusers and dedicated IPs are in the EU. Reads only, through the SendGridTools module, global or EU.

Prerequisites.Text: A SendGrid API key with Restricted Access and read scopes only: whitelabel.read, api_keys.read, user.settings.enforced_tls.read, subusers.read, ips.read. A test whose scope is missing is skipped and says so.
Maester installs the SendGridTools module 0.5.1 from the PowerShell Gallery with the pack.

Steps.Text: EU regional account or subuser (data residency in the EU).
Steps.Command: Connect-Maester -Service WEY.SENDGRID.Api -ServiceSetting @{ ApiKey = (Read-Host -AsSecureString 'SendGrid API key'); Region = 'EU' }

Commands.Text: Run the pack on its own.

Options.Name: MaximumScopes
Options.Text: MP.WEY.SENDGRID.1002: the most scopes an API key may have.

Options.Name: RequireValidCertificate
Options.Text: MP.WEY.SENDGRID.1003: also require a valid certificate from receiving servers.

Options.Name: MinimumVersion
Options.Text: MP.WEY.SENDGRID.1003: the lowest TLS version SendGrid may use.

AppOnly.Text: Runs unattended with the key in the MAESTER_WEY_SENDGRID_API_APIKEY environment variable (and MAESTER_WEY_SENDGRID_API_REGION = EU for an EU account). No Microsoft sign-in is needed.
